title: Restriction of abelian Zariski sheaves to an open is exact and preserves injectives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $X_{\rm Zar}$, $U_{\rm Zar}$ the small Zariski sites of $X$ and of $U$ [def-sc-zariski-site] (the objects of $U_{\rm Zar}$ are the opens $W\subseteq U$, which are also objects of $X_{\rm Zar}$, and a family of opens of $U$ is a covering in $U_{\rm Zar}$ if and only if it is one in $X_{\rm Zar}$). Let $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ and $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian categories of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $\mathcal F|_U\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal F(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal F$, and for a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ let $\varphi|_U:\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal G|_U$ have components $(\varphi|_U)_W=\varphi_W$. Then: (1) the functor $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F|_U$, is additive and exact (it carries a sequence exact at the middle term [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] to one exact at the middle term); (2) if $\mathcal I$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal I|_U$ is an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$; (3) consequently, if $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F$ in $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], then $\mathcal F|_U\to\mathcal I^\bullet|_U$ (the complex with terms $\mathcal I^p|_U$ and differentials $d^p|_U$) is an injective resolution of $\mathcal F|_U$ in $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, and $\Gamma(U,\mathcal I^\bullet|_U)=\mathcal I^\bullet(U)$ as complexes of abelian groups.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (label lemma-cohomology-of-open), line 607, parts (1) and (2) and its proof, applied to the ringed site (X_Zar, Z) (abelian sheaves = sheaves of Z-modules) and the object U, whose localized site X_Zar/U is U_Zar; the topological-space form is Cohomology of Sheaves, Lemma 01E1 (label lemma-cohomology-of-open), literature/stacks-project/cohomology.tex line 495, with O_X the constant sheaf Z. The proof there: restriction j_U^{-1} is right adjoint to the exact extension by zero j_{U!}, so it preserves injectives (Homology, Lemma 015Z adjoint-preserve-injectives).

proof.text: Step 1 (additivity). The Mathlib functor U.sheafRestrict is precomposition along the open-image functor, corestricted to sheaves. For two sheaf morphisms f and g, extensionality at each open reduces map (f + g) = map f + map g to reflexivity. This proves zariski_open_restriction_additive directly.

Step 2 (exactness). Mathlib TopologicalSpace.Opens.overPullbackSheafEquivOver identifies U.sheafRestrict definitionally with overPullback followed by the equivalence U.sheafEquivOver.functor. The overPullback is sheafPushforwardContinuous along Over.forget U, so it preserves finite limits by the proved source-library instance Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_sheafPushforwardContinuous. It preserves finite colimits by the proved source-library instance CategoryTheory.preservesFiniteColimits_overPullback (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Sites.ConstantSheafOver), since Over.forget U is cocontinuous and restriction is a left adjoint via right Kan extension. An equivalence preserves both limits and colimits. Hence restriction preserves homology, and ShortComplex.Exact.map sends any middle-exact short complex to a middle-exact short complex.

Step 3 (injectives). Let L be Mathlib Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback for Over.forget U from abelian sheaves on the localized site to abelian sheaves on X. Clause (2) of zariski_extensionByZero_exact gives a PreservesMonomorphisms instance for L. Mathlib sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous supplies L left adjoint to overPullback. Apply the Mathlib match of lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives, Functor.preservesInjectiveObjects_of_adjunction_of_preservesMonomorphisms, to this adjunction. Then compose with U.sheafEquivOver.functor, which preserves injectives because it is an equivalence. Under the definitional identification in Step 2 this proves injectivity after U.sheafRestrict.

Step 4 (resolution and sections). Write R = U.sheafRestrict. Step 2 supplies R.PreservesHomology using Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact, and Step 3 supplies R.PreservesInjectiveObjects. Construct J with cocomplex exactly R.mapHomologicalComplex applied to I.cocomplex; injectivity in degree n is R.injective_obj applied to I.cocomplex.X n. Its augmentation is the inverse of HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex at F followed by the mapped original augmentation. The first map is an isomorphism and the second a quasi-isomorphism by homology preservation, so J is an injective resolution. The comparison of cocomplexes is reflexivity, and the degree-zero augmentation equation follows from singleMapHomologicalComplex_inv_app_self. For the equality of section complexes, let f be the subtype inclusion U into X and hf its open-embedding proof. The image functor hf.isOpenMap.functor sends the terminal open to U, as follows by membership extensionality and the image of Subtype.val. Both complexes are definitionally evaluation of I.cocomplex at these opens. Applying congrArg to the evaluation-complex function gives equality including differentials.

split_report.summary: Checked against Cohomology on Sites 03F3 (statement (1) and proof), Cohomology 01E1, Modules on Sites 03DI/03DJ/04IX, Sheaves 00A4/00A5 and Homology 015Z. The module nodes (lem-weil-pbc-module-open-restriction-injectives, -module-extension-by-zero-adjunction) are stated for a scheme with its structure sheaf O_X, not an arbitrary sheaf of rings, and the DAG has no node identifying abelian sheaves on X_Zar with Z_X-modules, so the abelian case is proved directly following 03F3. Four steps: restriction is an additive functor (elementary, same coverings); exactness of restriction (not proved in 03F3) via sectionwise kernels (lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact (1)), the epi/kernel-lift criterion and epi = locally surjective on both sites; preservation of injectives by lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives (015Z, tool from unit sk-thm-groth-ss) applied to j_!, using two new unsplit nodes for the abelian Zariski extension by zero (adjunction, 03DI/00A5; exactness, 03DJ); restricted injective resolutions and Gamma(U, I|_U) = I(U), which is clause (3) used by lem-weil-pbc-zariski-cohomology-locally-zero step 3. Statement kept. Mathlib: no match (composition of injective_of_adjoint, sheafAdjunctionContinuous and a missing mono-preservation of j_!).

reviewed: pass (L, 2026-10-10): 4 steps follow 03F3 for abelian Zariski sheaves: restriction is additive and exact (kernels sectionwise, epimorphisms locally surjective), extension by zero j_! is an exact left adjoint (two new unsplit nodes 03DI/04IX and 03DJ), so restriction preserves injectives via lem-sp-right-adjoint-preserves-injectives (tool_uses recorded by L), and restricted injective resolutions are injective resolutions.
